content.rendered:
Giving Tuesday is an annual day of giving that occurs on the first Tuesday after Thanksgiving. This year’s Giving Tuesday is TODAY, Tuesday, November 30. We have secured a pledge to match $15,000 in donations! The first $15,000 in donations will be matched 100%.

With all of our regular fundraisers cancelled in 2020 and 2021 due to the pandemic, we are hopeful that Giving Tuesday will be a rousing success. Please give as generously as possible.

 

 

A COPY OF THE OFFICIAL REGISTRATION AND FINANCIAL INFORMATION MAY BE OBTAINED FROM THE DIVISION OF CONSUMER SERVICES BY CALLING 1-800-435-7352 TOLL FREE WITHIN THE STATE, OR BY GOING ONLINE TO www.FloridaConsumerHelp.com. REGISTRATION DOES NOT IMPLY ENDORSEMENT, APPROVAL, OR RECOMMENDATION BY THE STATE. REGISTRATION NUMBER CH11012

GivingTuesday is a global generosity movement unleashing the power of generosity. Whatever you can donate today will go directly to the Florida Poodle Rescue dogs.

And today only, double your donation! The first $15,000 in donations will be matched 100%!
